REPORT ON CLOSED SESSION ACTIONS (CITY ATTORNEY) Mayor announces report coming from Los Angeles County Public Works Department.
Mark Pestrella, Public Works Director for L.A. County, Angela George-Moody, Chief Deputy with PW, Russ Bryden, Asst. Dir. of PW.
Pestrella, gave a brief overview of the Dominguez Channel odor condition. they discover a source of an illicit discharge of materials in the channel, such as pallets, cardboard pieces, some actions which maybe criminal. The use of epolidom an organic spray which they will begin spraying on tomorrow and a difference should be noticed in three days from the time of spraying, and placing aireation that will provide air into the contaminated area.

Stated the reimburse department in up and running call 211 and mention the Dominguez Channel Odor incident and the operator will direct you to where you need to go.
Reimbursement 3 options:
1. homes with heating and ac units
2. reimburse households with 
3. would like to be relocated up to $182.00 per day hotel, food $66.00 per person per household.

Pestrella, residents need to state if they can put the money up, install or pick up the unit, please state that on your application so they would know how to address your situation.

Mayor what about hospital fees, Pestrella hold on to all receipts for possible reimbursement.

Hicks, regarding being home and you use the Hepa purifier and your utility bill goes up is that reimbursable? Pestrella, yes it is hold on to your receipts.
Hicks, bring someone from the water dept. to speak on the water condition.

Hicks, hotel rental prices change on a day by day, will this be looked at on a case by case basis. Pestrella, they will work with the hotels they have already discussed stays with to check for a weekly rate.

Hicks, residents who are already at the channel have already moved, will the county do retro payment for those residents. Pestrella, yes it will be looked at
